paper_title: When Function Follows Form: Effects of Donor Copolymer Side Chains on Film Morphology and BHJ Solar Cell Performance
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2010 - Szarko - When Function Follows Form  Effects of Donor Copolymer Side Chains on Film Morphology/auto/Advanced Materials - 2010 - Szarko - When Function Follows Form  Effects of Donor Copolymer Side Chains on Film Morphology.md

knowledge_points.content: PTB-series polymers, composed of alternating thieno[3,4-b]thiophene (TT) and benzodithiophene (BDT) units, exhibit a 'face-on' backbone orientation where $\pi$-conjugated planes lie parallel to the substrate, unlike the 'edge-on' orientation typical of P3HT.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the first PTB polymer of this series, PTB1, we discovered a remarkable 'face-on' polymer backbone orientation... In contrast, most other bulk-heterojunction (BHJ)-OPV materials, such as poly-3 hexylthiophene (P3HT), have a strong preference for an 'edge-on' orientation.

knowledge_points.content: Bulk-heterojunction solar cells based on PTB polymers blended with PCBM (PC61BM or PC71BM) have achieved power conversion efficiencies (PCE) of approximately 8%.
knowledge_points.evidence: It was recently reported that PTB polymers... yield unprecedented ≈ 8% PCEs when blended in a bulk-heterojunction (BHJ) structure with electron acceptor materials such as [6,6]-phenyl-C61(71) butyric acid methyl ester.

knowledge_points.content: The branched alkyl side chains attached to the benzodithiophene (BDT) unit in PTB polymers increase the $\pi-\pi$ stacking distance and decrease the power conversion efficiency (PCE) compared to linear side chains.
knowledge_points.evidence: branched side chains attached at the BDT unit cause an increase in the π-π stacking spacing in films and a decrease in the OPV device PCE... resulting in a π-π stacking distance of 3.65 Å for PTB1 versus 3.89 Å for PTB5.

knowledge_points.content: Branched alkyl side chains attached to the thienothiophene (TT) unit in PTB polymers do not significantly alter the $\pi-\pi$ stacking distance but can enhance the power conversion efficiency (PCE) by improving interactions with PCBM.
knowledge_points.evidence: branched side chains attached at the TT unit do not interfere with the π-π stacking spacing in the film and enhance the OPV device PCE... While the TT unit side chains do not significantly alter the π-π stacking d spacing, the device PCE increases substantially when the side chain is a branched alkyl group.

knowledge_points.content: In PTB polymers, the fill factor (FF) of the resulting organic photovoltaic devices shows a strong positive correlation with the strength of $\pi-\pi$ interactions, where closer stacking distances lead to higher FFs.
knowledge_points.evidence: there is a positive correlation between the strength of π-π interactions through the polymer backbone stacking in the film and the OPV device fill factor (FF)... the closer π-π stacking distance in the polymer film gives the larger FF in its corresponding BHJ device.

knowledge_points.content: The use of 3% 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a processing additive in PTB:PCBM blends enhances the polymer crystallinity and the relative peak area of $\pi-\pi$ stacking domains by up to a factor of three.
knowledge_points.evidence: When the films are fabricated using 3% 1,8 diiodooctane (DIO) in the solution... the relative peak area corresponding to the π-π stacking domains in the films prepared with DIO is enhanced by a factor of 3.

knowledge_points.content: GISAXS characterization reveals that PTB:PCBM films lack the 5-10 nm PCBM domain features typically found in P3HT:PCBM films, suggesting a more finely dispersed or intercalated PCBM network.
knowledge_points.evidence: For the P3HT:PCBM film, the average P3HT and PCBM domain dimension is 5-10 nm... In contrast, the PTB6 and PTB3 films do not exhibit a large feature in the form factor... PCBM domain sizes are smaller in PTB:PCBM films compared to the P3HT:PCBM films.

knowledge_points.content: The 'face-on' orientation of PTB polymers facilitates charge transport across the interface between the organic photoactive layer and the PEDOT:PSS-coated ITO anode.
knowledge_points.evidence: This orientation of the π-π stacked structures would favor charge transport across the interface... binding most strongly to the anode interfacial layer, facilitating electronic communication across the interface.

knowledge_points.content: In PTB polymers, the BDT moiety dominates $\pi-\pi$ stacking interactions due to its bulkier three-ring fused heterocyclic structure compared to the two-ring TT moiety.
knowledge_points.evidence: Because the BDT moiety has three fused heterocyclic rings with two attached side chains and is bulkier than the TT moiety with two fused heterocyclic rings with one attached side chain, BDT dominates the π-π stacking interactions.

knowledge_points.content: The degree of polymer packing order in BHJ films can be characterized by the GIWAXS area ratio of the polymer $\pi-\pi$ stacking peak (≈1.7 Å⁻¹) to the PCBM intramolecular peak (≈1.4 Å⁻¹).
knowledge_points.evidence: The area ratio of the Gaussian peaks for the PCBM domain at 1.4 Å⁻¹ (APCB M) and the polymer π-π stacking at ≈1.7 Å⁻¹ (APTB) was used to characterize the degree of polymer packing order in the films.
